name: prompt-master
description: Turns rough prompts into clear ones and recommends the model and effort level to run them. Type pm: before a prompt. Works for code, email, study and research.

interface.longDescription:
Prompt Master rewrites a rough prompt into a clear one, shows you the rewrite, then answers it. For anyone who writes prompts in a hurry: students, people writing emails at work, and developers using Codex.

Type pm: before a prompt, or a preset like pm email: or pm study:. Type ep: before a task to get a model and effort recommendation. Type pm help to see every command.

It gives advice only, keeps no data, and its model picks are a rule of thumb you can always override.
capabilities: Rewrite rough prompts into clear ones
Recommend a model and effort level
Presets for code, email, study and research
Plan Codex tasks with ep codex
defaultPrompt: pm email: follow up with a client who hasn't replied in a week
ep: compare two job offers and help me decide
